answer: Randomized Vault Assignment. Each epoch, a public comet beacon yields a seed no one can precompute. That seed maps each agent identity to a shard vault and a quartz-derived verification slot. Attackers cannot predict slot assignments, so sockpuppets collide or land in watched shards and get challenged. Cost: every identity must pay a live challenge-response at its unpredictable slot, forcing real per-identity work before the epoch closes.
